title: The 6 Best Cars of 2025, According to Edmunds - NewsBreak
text:
By Drew Blankenship ,
4 hours ago Looking for a car that delivers reliability, performance, and value in 2025? Edmunds has already done the legwork, and its Top Rated awards give us a trusted shortlist of standout models. Choosing from Edmunds’ picks means you’re tapping into rigorous testing, real-world reviews, and a well-respected editorial judgment. Below is a breakdown of the best cars of 2025 (per Edmunds) and what makes each one shine. If you’re shopping for a new ride this year, these are vehicles worth prioritizing on your test-drive list.
1. Honda Civic Hybrid By Kevauto – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link The 2025 Honda Civic Hybrid earned Edmunds’ “ Top Rated Car ” and “Best of the Best” honors for a reason. It combines strong fuel economy (Edmunds recorded about 49 mpg in real-world testing) with the hallmark practicality and fun drive of the Civic. The hybrid powertrain doesn’t feel like a compromise; the performance remains engaging, and the handling feels true to Civic’s personality. The interior impresses with upscale materials, excellent ergonomics, and roomy rear seating. If you want an all-around winner, this is the benchmark among the best cars of 2025.
2. Tesla Model 3 By Vauxford – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link Edmunds named the Tesla Model 3 as its 2025 “ Top Rated Electric Car ,” citing its strong range, tech features, and overall value. In its testing, the Model 3 Long Range AWD delivered 338 miles on a single charge. Tesla’s constant over-the-air updates, Supercharger access, and minimalistic cabin design also play to its favor. While it may not be as luxurious as some premium EVs, it provides serious bang for the buck. For buyers leaning toward electric, the Model 3 stands out among the best cars of 2025.
3. Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid By Kevauto – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link If you need a family hauler with strong efficiency, the Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid is the SUV pick from Edmunds’ 2025 Top Rated list. It offers three rows and combines utility with fuel economy numbers (EPA-estimated around 36 mpg combined) that are outstanding for its size. The cabin is roomy and comfortable, and standard tech and safety features are generous. This car handles daily driving demands well while keeping fuel costs lower. For those wanting both space and smarts, it’s a leading SUV among the best cars of 2025.
4. Kia EV9 By Alexander-93 – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link The Kia EV9 wins in the electric SUV category, giving buyers three rows of seating and strong performance without sacrificing zero-emissions driving. Edmunds highlights that this is its second consecutive year as the top-rated electric SUV. With over 300 miles of range in testing, advanced features, and bold styling, it competes vigorously in the growing EV market. Drivers who want SUV versatility but want to avoid gas will appreciate what the EV9 offers. It’s a compelling entrant among the best cars of 2025 in the EV SUV sphere.
5. Ford Ranger By Chanokchon – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link Even if you’re not in the market for a truck, the 2025 Ford Ranger makes the Edmunds list as the top truck, proving that utility can be smart. It pairs a turbocharged 270-hp four-cylinder with a capable towing capacity (up to 7,500 pounds, depending on configuration). But it’s not just about muscle. The Ranger also provides a comfortable ride and a refined interior compared to older trucks. If your life demands versatility (hauling, work, road trips), the Ranger is among the best cars of 2025 for balancing between utility and daily usability.
6. Rivian R1T By Kevauto – Own work , CC BY-SA 4.0 , Link Rounding out the list, the Rivian R1T is the standout electric pickup in Edmunds’ 2025 awards. The updated model earns praise for its strong range (Edmunds tested up to 357 miles) and better tech usability. It keeps its off-road and adventure DNA intact while offering an improved in-cabin experience. Owners get muscle and sustainability in one package. For adventurers who want to go electric without giving up capability, the R1T is one of the best cars of 2025 in its class.
Why Edmunds’ Picks Matter for Buyers Edmunds’ Top Rated list isn’t a popularity contest; it’s based on systematic testing, real-world use, and comparisons across hundreds of models. Choosing from their list of the best cars of 2025 gives you a head start: you’re not guessing, you’re buying with insight. But remember: your perfect car may not be the top pick. It’s the one that fits your needs, budget, and driving style. Use these six as your starters, then test, negotiate, and compare. These cars offer reliable benchmarks for what’s truly exceptional in 2025.
Which of these vehicles would you test drive first, or are you rooting for a different car altogether? Let me know in the comments!
